# routeur_me (Data Source)

Who the provider's API token acts as, in which organisation. Useful to check credentials or to read the organisation slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "routeur_me" "current" {}

output "organisation" {
  value = data.routeur_me.current.organisation.slug
}

output "token_expires_at" {
  value = data.routeur_me.current.token.expires_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `organisation` (Attributes) The organisation the token belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organisation))
- `token` (Attributes) The API token itself (never its secret). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token))
- `user` (Attributes) The user who minted the token; the token acts with their permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

<a id="nestedatt--organisation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organisation`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The organisation's display name.
- `slug` (String) The organisation slug: the provider's `org` argument.


<a id="nestedatt--token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String) When the token expires (RFC 3339, UTC); null when it does not.
- `fingerprint` (String) Non-secret fingerprint of the token, e.g. `rtm_…abcd`.
- `name` (String) The name given to the token when it was minted.


<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) Public id of the user (`user_…`).
- `name` (String) The user's name.
